text_block_list.text:
In every era, in every corner of the world,
there is always one person
who stands
head and shoulders above their peers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
At Академия Тайсен, this maxim remains
ever constant.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
And crossing the finish line in first place,
leagues ahead of the
competition, is
Симболи Рудольф! What a performance!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
Phew... Victory secured. I'm on the right
track.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Promising new racers are gathered here at
the tryouts, eager to prove
themselves to
prospective trainers.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
But... Симболи Рудольф has won by such an
insurmountable lead, her
poor rivals pale
in comparison.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She even outshadowed her own personal
best. The sheer power she
demonstrated
left all of us dumbfounded.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
To all in the stands, allow me to extend
my gratitude. Your cheers of

encouragement led me to this victory.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And to you, trainers: did my performance
today satisfy your
expectations?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I realize that I still have far to travel in my
journey to the top, and I
leave much room
for improvement.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
To that end, I seek a comrade in arms who
will march this imperial
path with me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If you share my vision, I implore you to put
your name forward.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Th-that's easier said than done. She's
clearly talented beyond belief,
but...
text_block_list.name: New Trainer A

text_block_list.text:
Y-yeah... If her trainer is unable to guide
her to victory... their
reputation will be
shredded.
text_block_list.name: Trainers

text_block_list.text:
They're not wrong. From a trainer's
perspective, taking on a runner
like
Симболи Рудольф is a huge risk.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
In the end, no one can muster the courage
to put themselves in the
running, and we
all disperse.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Steady, now... One last push!
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
With the homestretch ahead of her,
Симболи Рудольф picks up speed,
leaving
her competitors lagging behind!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
She's unstoppable! Her reign is absolute!
We're seeing a run worthy of
the Triple
Crown!
text_block_list.name: Комментатор

text_block_list.text:
No matter how hard I try, I can't get
Симболи Рудольф's overwhelmingly
powerful
strides out of my mind.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Needless to say, sleep doesn't come easily
to me that night.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
The next day, I head to the training
grounds.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Ah, a trainer... I remember seeing you at
the tryouts.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
You were at the race, and now you've
come to speak to me directly.
May I
presume you're here to scout me?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Then I've but one question for you: why do
you wish to be my Тренер?
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф
choice_data_list: I want to see more of your running.

text_block_list.text:
Hm, I see. "More of my running," you say. I
suppose that means you
see future
potential in me.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
For your reference, you're the third trainer
I've had this conversation
with.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
The first spoke of his determination to
make me stronger. The second
spoke of
her commitment to working toward my
goal together.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Three days from now, I will ask each of you
for your reasoning again.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I would like you to provide a concrete
example of your plan to me
then.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I apologize for testing you like this. But I
can't make the decision
lightly, you see.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
I am to stand at the absolute zenith, as a
guiding light to all
Umamusume. That is
the mission I've given myself.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
If I'm to reach such lofty heights, I can't
afford to compromise.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
Well, then. We will meet again three days
hence. I look forward to
your answer.
text_block_list.name: Симболи Рудольф

text_block_list.text:
And as the last words leave her lips,
Rudolf looks straight into my
eyes with a
calm, composed smile.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
